name: Bala Big and Blind 2019

venue.name: Bala Cynwyd Middle School
venue.address: 510 Bryn Mawr Ave, Bala Cynwyd, PA 19004
venue.details: The sidewalk at the parking lot leads to the venue. Follow the signs.

information: If you want to be on the competitor list, sign up and pay as soon as possible! The registration fee will go to an organization called buildOn. you can visit their website at https://www.buildon.org/. There will tentative pyraminx and 4x4 finals (in that order) if time permits. **The main event of this competition is 6x6**
